fieldValues.title: Remedy
fieldValues.theory: A remedy is a move that answers one or more problems. It carries a **falsifier** (what would show it failed) and a **return_when** (when to look again). Agents suggest one to three remedies per domain; the owner affirms them; an existing epic implements each one.
fieldValues.practice:
- Type `com.semanticops.method/remedy`, linked to problems by `answers`.
- `check-method` requires an affirmed remedy to answer an affirmed problem and to carry a falsifier.
- 5 records: two affirmed remedies with their suggestions, and one suggested remedy (lenses).
open_questions: Who checks a falsifier, and when: each report, or period close?
What happens when a falsifier fires?
fieldValues.test: Stage 5: 2 passing; pending: falsifiers and return_when evaluated.
